judgments.note: Municipal ZBA conditional use appeal is clear; the only document is a scheduling entry that never describes the proposal. An appellee named Twin Pines Housing Trust hints at housing but does not establish new housing, so housing is unknown and the case uncertain.
Nothing states what the conditional use is for; the housing trust's role suggests housing but is not evidence of the proposal.
Town of Hartford appears as interested person; the ZBA is not named as Hartford's in so many words.
No attorney listed for the appellants (filer's attorney line blank, notified directly) and they sought time 'to potentially retain legal representation', which says they are currently unrepresented.
Names are explicit; relationship (likely neighbors) and what they seek (likely overturning an approval) are not stated, so unknown.
Nothing says whether the appeal is on the record or de novo; discovery and mediation hint at de novo but do not establish it.
Start on or before the August 19, 2019 status conference; end on or after the September 26, 2019 order with mediation pending; 38 days at least.
Mediation and a further status conference are pending as of the order.
